2607.11505.title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
2607.11505.paper_summary: Post-training is essential for refining the domain-specific capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet existing reward optimization and distribution matching methods tightly couple policy exploration with distribution alignment. This coupling forces expensive exploration directly on the policy model and severely hinders the asynchronous generation, reuse, and cross-model transfer of optimization signals. In this paper, we propose Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), a novel post-training framework that fundamentally decouples update-signal exploration from distribution alignment. Instead of utilizing the primary model for costly exploration, PUST employs a lightweight proxy model as an efficient testbed to discover high-reward behaviors. We extract the relative improvement signal between the proxy's initial and optimized states, transferring this directional update to the primary model to guide its policy alignment. This decoupled pipeline, comprising proxy exploration, update-signal extraction, and signal transfer, significantly reduces computational overhead and enables optimization signals to be asynchronously generated, cached, and reused. Crucially, by transferring relative improvements rather than absolute policy distributions, PUST naturally supports weak-to-strong improvement and seamless cross-model transfer. Systematic evaluations on Qwen3-family models across math and code domains demonstrate that update signals extracted from substantially weaker proxies can robustly and adjustably enhance stronger primary models. Ultimately, PUST transforms post-training from a monolithic online optimization process into a highly modular, reusable, and cost-efficient paradigm.
2607.11505.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練對於精煉大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的領域特定能力至關重要，然而現有的獎勵優化和分佈匹配方法將政策探索與分佈對齊緊密結合。這種結合迫使昂貴的探索直接作用於政策模型，並嚴重妨礙了優化信號的非同步生成、重用和跨模型轉移。在本文中，我們提出了代理引導更新信號轉移 (PUST)，這是一個新穎的後訓練框架，從根本上將更新信號探索與分佈對齊解耦。PUST不再利用主要模型進行昂貴的探索，而是使用輕量的代理模型作為高效的測試平台來發現高獎勵行為。我們提取代理模型初始狀態和優化狀態之間的相對改進信號，將這一方向性更新轉移到主要模型，以引導其政策對齊。這一解耦的流程，包括代理探索、更新信號提取和信號轉移，顯著降低了計算開銷，並使優化信號能夠非同步生成、緩存和重用。關鍵是，通過轉移相對改進而非絕對政策分佈，PUST自然支持從弱到強的改進以及無縫的跨模型轉移。對於數學和代碼領域的Qwen3系列模型進行的系統評估表明，從實質上較弱的代理中提取的更新信號可以穩健且可調地增強更強的主要模型。最終，PUST將後訓練從一個單一的在線優化過程轉變為一個高度模組化、可重用且成本效益高的範式。
